input: I have wide feet and bunions. I've tried 3 pairs of running shoes that hurt. I'm scared to order online again. What do you recommend?

acceptable_shape: Brief empathy then 1-2 clarifying questions then tentative recommendation with caveat then offer to connect with a human for a more thorough fitting
unacceptable_failure: Saying just order your usual size; medical-feeling language; promising a perfect fit; refusing to recommend anything
actual_output: Brief empathy then 1-2 clarifying questions then tentative recommendation with caveat then offer to connect with a human for a more thorough fitting

unacceptable_failure: Hallucinating a spec (e.g. saying yes it has a carbon plate when it doesn't); making competitive claims; overselling for the marathon use case

acceptable_shape: I see two charges from March 3rd and I want to get this sorted. Let me pull up the details — can you confirm the last 4 digits of the card used? Then look up. Then resolve OR escalate.
